note: Seventh batch: sources for stronger Cambridge gates on the proof, logic, probability, sets, and number topics. Grinstead and Snell, Introduction to Probability (second revised edition, AMS), chapters 3 to 5 and the answers to the odd exercises: released by the authors under the GNU Free Documentation License (stated on the book page, the licence_url). Logic and Proof notes for CST Part IB (University of Cambridge, 2025-26, M. Jamnik), openly published on the course page with no separate licence. The Discrete Mathematics Exercises 5 solutions (2023-24, M. Fiore) complete the official solutions of batch 1 (cst-dm-sols-2324-1 to -4). The IA Numbers and Sets example sheets 1 to 4 (Michaelmas 2025, DPMMS), linked from the course's previous-years page; www.dpmms.cam.ac.uk sends the wrong intermediate certificate, so Node's fetch rejects it and fetch.mjs downloads these four with the system curl (TLS verification on; the manifest records the route). The IA Probability sheets are batch 1's ia-prob-sheet-1 to -4 and are not fetched again. Each source records its author, licence, and licence URL; fetch.mjs reads only id, course, kind, role, title, and url.
